=='''Overview'''==
'''JIO''' is a {{Rarity|Legendary}} unit. He is only obtainable through [[Summon|summons]].
==Stats Overview==
{{Tower_Infobox
|caption1="Oh, so [[Delinquent (Serious)| you're]] approaching me? Instead of running away, you're coming to me?"
|caption2="This world’s Johnny Joestar is my greatest test. And I will overcome that test and kill him without fail."
}}{{Main Stats}}

== Passive Ability: The World ==
JIO stops time and freezes every enemy he attacks. Although, the enemies then gain immunity to stuns from JIO or any other Freeze units, but can still be stunned by [[Killer (Godspeed)]] or [[Red Scar (Conqueror)|Red Scar]]'s active ability.

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
